query:
select
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
age as "Age",
sex as "Sex",
village as "Village",
facility as "Facility",
department as "Department",
concat_ws(', ', location_group, location) as "Location",
laboratory as "Laboratory",
request_id as "Request ID",
status as "Status",
to_char(((requested_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Lab request date and time",
requested_by as "Requesting clinician",
requesting_department as "Requesting department",
priority as "Priority",
lab_test_category as "Test category",
tests as "Test requested",
to_char(((collected_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Sample collection date and time",
collected_by as "Sample collected by",
specimen_type as "Specimen type",
site as "Site",
to_char(((completed_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Completed date and time",
reason_for_cancellation as "Reason for cancellation"
from "reporting"."ds__lab_requests"
where case
when 
:requestedById is null then true
else requested_by_id = 
:requestedById
end
and
case
when 
:testCategoryId is null then true
else lab_test_category_id = 
:testCategoryId
end
and
case
when 
:statusId is null then true
else status_id = 
:statusId
end
and
((requested_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
>= 
:fromDate
and
((requested_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
<= 
:toDate
order by requested_datetime, last_name, first_name, tests
name: Lab requests line list
notes:
This report generates a list of all patients that have had a lab request created and details of the request for the selected parameters. Patients are listed in chronological order based on the lab request date and time.  

The report includes lab requests for all statuses and if a request has been cancelled will display the reason for cancellation.
